# Preamble

```{r preamble}
library(here)
here()
#----------------------------
# source the config file
#----------------------------
source(here("R","0-config.R"))
```

# Load the clean GPP-TAC longitudinal  data

```{r load gpp tac longitudinal data}

#-------------------------------
# read in the processed GPP and TAC data
# These data were copied from
# the ECoMiD sharepoint directory
# on february 24, 2026 (data version 2/24/2026); they include TAC results only for salmonella
#-------------------------------

d1 <-  read_csv(file = here("../../data/gpp-tac-longitudinal/","pcr_pathogens_tac_gpp_20260610.csv")) 
length(unique(d1$house_ID))

#-------------------------------
# there are currently empty rows
# for 21m measurement 
# 
# filter to ages with measurements
#-------------------------------
d2 <- d1 %>%
  filter(visit %in% c("3m","6m","9m","12m","15m","18m","24m")) %>%
  # format visit as factor and integer for convenience
  mutate(visitf = factor(visit, levels=c("3m","6m","9m","12m","15m","18m","24m")),
         visit = as.integer(gsub("m","",visit))
         )
length(unique(d2$house_ID))

#-------------------------------
# create child ID from
# sampleid (first 6 characters)
# identify community and community
# type from sample ID
#
# NOTE: this is kind of a patch
# because it only works for
# children with samples
# from the 520 children in the
# cohort, there are 484 children
# included in the dataset with
# at least one sample (36 without)
#-------------------------------
d3 <- d2 %>%
  mutate(childid = substr(sample_ID,1,6),
    community = substr(childid,1,1),
    community_name = case_when(
      community=="E" ~ "Esmeraldas",
      community=="B" ~ "Borbon",
      community=="M" ~ "Maldonado",
      community=="C" ~ "Colon de Onzole",
      community=="S" ~ "Santo Domingo",
      community=="T" ~ "Timbire",
      community=="Z" ~ "Zancudo",
      community=="A" ~ "Selva Alegre",
      community=="L" ~ "Colon Eloy",
      community=="F" ~ "San Francisco"
    ),
    community_type = case_when(
      community_name == "Esmeraldas" ~ "Esmeraldas",
      community_name == "Borbon" ~ "Borbon",
      community_name %in% c("Maldonado", "Colon Eloy", "Timbire", "Zancudo", "Selva Alegre") ~ "Rural Road",
      community_name %in% c("Zancudo", "Colon de Onzole", "Santo Domingo", "San Francisco") ~ "Rural River"
      ),
    community_type = factor(community_type, levels = c("Esmeraldas","Borbon", "Rural Road","Rural River"))
   ) %>%
  # fill community info in within child
  group_by(house_ID) %>%
  fill(community, .direction = "downup") %>%
  fill(community_name, .direction = "downup") %>%
  fill(community_type, .direction = "downup") %>%
  # identify taxa
  mutate(taxa = case_when(
    pathogen %in% c("Adenovirus_40_41","Norovirus_GI","Norovirus_GII","Rotavirus") ~ "Virus",
    pathogen %in% c("Cryptosporidium","Entamoeba_histolytica","Giardia") ~ "Protozoan",
    TRUE ~ as.character("Bacteria")
  ),
  taxa = factor(taxa, levels = c("Bacteria","Protozoan","Virus"))
         )
length(unique(d3$house_ID))

#-------------------------------
# filter to measurements
# with samples collected and
# results
#
# subset to relevant variables
#-------------------------------
d4 <- d3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample_ID)) %>%
  select(childid,house_ID,community,community_name,community_type,sample_ID,visitf,visit,pathogen,pcr_assay,pcrpos=presence) 
length(unique(d4$house_ID))

#-------------------------------
# summarize the number of samples
# by community and by visit
#
# and by community type and by visit
#
# (use Noro GII as an example)
#-------------------------------
cbind(table(d4$community_name[d4$pathogen=="Norovirus_GII"]))
table(d4$community_name[d4$pathogen=="Norovirus_GII"],d4$visit[d4$pathogen=="Norovirus_GII"])

cbind(table(d4$community_type[d4$pathogen=="Norovirus_GII"]))
table(d4$community_type[d4$pathogen=="Norovirus_GII"],d4$visit[d4$pathogen=="Norovirus_GII"])

#-------------------------------
# summarize the assay used
# at each age of measurement
# GPP at ages 3,  9, 24
# TAC at ages 6, 12, 18
#-------------------------------
table(d4$visitf[d4$pathogen=="Norovirus_GII"],d4$pcr_assay[d4$pathogen=="Norovirus_GII"])

#-------------------------------
# Add in pre-covid and post-covid data
#-------------------------------
# add in pre-COVID or post-COVID cohort indicator 
a1 <- read.xlsx(here("../../Data/ecomid-field/untouched-2025-08-12/A1.xlsx"), detectDates = TRUE)
a1$childid <- sprintf("%04d", a1$house_ID)

recruited_pre_covid <- a1 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(house_ID)) %>% 
  filter(date_int <= "2020-03-22") %>%
  dplyr::select(date_int, childid) 

recruited_post_covid <- a1 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(house_ID)) %>%
  filter(date_int > "2020-03-22") %>%
  dplyr::select(date_int, childid) 

d5 <- d4 %>% 
  mutate(post_covid = ifelse(childid %in% recruited_post_covid$childid, 1, 0))

print("number of pre-covid and post-covid children in the final pcr sample set")
t1 <- d5 %>% ungroup() %>% select(childid, post_covid) %>% unique()
table(t1$post_covid)

# check the pre-covid samples
precovid <- d5 %>% ungroup %>% filter(post_covid == 0) 
table(precovid$visitf[precovid$pathogen=="Norovirus_GII"],precovid$pcr_assay[precovid$pathogen=="Norovirus_GII"])

#-------------------------_#
# Generate sample set list with missing 3 month sample to see if can match missing childid sample
#--------------------------#
missing_3month_id <- d5 %>%
  filter(!childid %in% (d5 %>% filter(visit == 3) %>% pull(childid))) %>%
  pull(childid) %>%
  unique()

# filter down dataset that has missing 3 month data and filter to those closest to #BB242003mHN1
missing_3month <- d5 %>% filter(childid %in% missing_3month_id,
                                str_detect(sample_ID, "BB"))
unique(missing_3month$childid)
BB_miss_id <- missing_3month %>% pull(childid) %>% unique() %>% as.data.frame() %>% rename(childid = ".")
write.csv(BB_miss_id, here("output/missing_3month_samples_ids.csv"))

# households that were excluded from step 2
excluded_hh <- d2 %>% filter(!house_ID %in% d4$house_ID)
length(unique(excluded_hh$house_ID))
#35 HHID were excluded
has_real_3month <- excluded_hh %>% 
  filter(visit == 3 & !is.na(sample_ID)) %>% 
  select(house_ID) %>% 
  distinct()

missing_3month <- excluded_hh %>%
  anti_join(has_real_3month, by = "house_ID") %>%
  select(house_ID) %>%
  distinct()
write.csv(missing_3month, here("output/excludedcohort_3month_samples_ids.csv"))
```

# Save processed data

```{r save data}
#-------------------------------
# save processed data
#-------------------------------
# change pathogen nomenclature to match serology 
d6 <- d5 %>% mutate(pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "ETEC_LT" ~ "LT-ETEC", 
                                              pathogen == "Entamoeba_histolytica" ~ "E. histolytica",
                                              pathogen == "Salmonella_enterica" ~ "Salmonella", 
                                              pathogen == "Norovirus_GI" ~ "Norovirus GI", 
                                              pathogen == "Norovirus_GII" ~ "Norovirus GII",
                                         pathogen == "Shigella" ~ "Shigella/EIEC",
                                         TRUE ~ pathogen))
                    
write_rds(d6, file=here("data","ecomid_pcr_analysis_data_2026-06-11.rds"))
write_csv(d6, file=here("data","ecomid_pcr_analysis_data_2026-06-11.csv"))
```
